# Religion Statistical @ Stage 1 — Prehension

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 1 |
| Canonical name | Prehension |
| Altitude | `infrared` (Pre-egocentric) |

| Kegan | Pre-Kegan |

## Expression on this line

Religious capacity at Order 0 is pre-religious differentiation: the bare physical capacity
of a system to differentiate one sacred configuration from another — a space that feels
different, a time that feels charged, an object that feels significant. This is the floor
beneath all religious life: the bare precondition for any later sacred experience is that
the system can differentiate the sacred from the profane.

There is no interior religious awareness, no sacred experience, no institutional religion.
The "religious" at this stage is entirely implicit in the system's physical structure.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** no interior correlate — no religious awareness, no sacred experience.\n- **UR:** reliable differential sacred response — the system responds differently to sacred
  versus profane configurations.\n- **LL:** none — no shared religious framework.\n- **LR:** the physical structure itself as the sole vehicle of sacred differentiation.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** not applicable at Order 0.\n- **Dark this is the floor.\n- **Golden addiction:** not applicable.\n- **Golden allergy:** the absence of any religious trajectory is a structural ceiling.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Sacred differentiation only:** the system responds differently to sacred versus profane
  configurations.\n- **No interior religious awareness:** the differentiation is entirely physical.\n- **No convention:** the response is entirely determined by physical structure.

## Sources, joints, open questions

Sacred and the Profane* (sacred differentiation as religious floor).\n**Open joints:** Where does physical sacred differentiation shade into proto-religious response?
